# Anvil — interactive labs (https://edu.hartwell-labs.pl)

> Hartwell Labs' interactive platform: cybersecurity, Python, Ruby and Rust. Write code,
> > it runs in your browser (Python through WebAssembly), and the checker tells you which
> > test failed. Labs that need a real machine run in a downloadable lab VM.
Generated 2026-10-15. Machine-readable task manifest: https://edu.hartwell-labs.pl/api/manifest

## Access

- **A free account is required** to open any lab: nickname, e-mail, password
  (`POST /api/auth/register`). One confirmation e-mail is sent; `GET
  /api/auth/verify?token=…` confirms the address.
- **Every task in the catalogue is free** once you have an account. There is no paid tier
  and no price list — paid work is custom (labs for a team, a private group, a lab machine
  built around your stack) and quoted per conversation.
- Sessions: 32 random bytes in an HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie, 60-day expiry.
- Passwords are stretched in the browser (PBKDF2-SHA256, 210 000 iterations); only the
  verifier reaches the server, which compares it in constant time.
- `GET /api/manifest` returns all 16 tasks. `GET /api/me` returns profile, progress, streak.

## Pages

- [Home](https://edu.hartwell-labs.pl/): tracks, how it works, the lab VM
- [Lab](https://edu.hartwell-labs.pl/lab): the runner — sign in, pick a track, write code, run it
- [Lab VM](https://edu.hartwell-labs.pl/lab-vm/README.md): the downloadable machine for systems labs
- [Build script](https://edu.hartwell-labs.pl/lab-vm/build.sh): builds the image or runs it in host mode
- [Task manifest](https://edu.hartwell-labs.pl/api/manifest): every task as JSON

## Execution model

| Executor | Meaning | Where it runs |
|---|---|---|
| `pyodide` | Python 3 in WebAssembly | learner's browser, runtime served from this domain |
| `quiz` | one correct answer, no code | browser |
| `vm` | needs a kernel, network or compiler | downloaded lab VM, verified locally by `labcheck` |

- **Turn a log line into structure** (`py-01-authlog`, difficulty 1, 100 pts, pyodide) — A log line looks like `IP - - [ts] "METHOD path" status`. Complete `parse_line` so it returns a tuple `(ip, method, status)` with `status` as an `i...
- **Verify a checksum** (`py-02-digest`, difficulty 2, 120 pts, pyodide) — You have the file bytes and an expected digest. Complete `sha256_hex` so it returns the hex digest. **Watch the trap**: unbounded `int(digest, 16)`...
- **Three layers of encryption** (`py-03-decoder`, difficulty 2, 150 pts, pyodide) — The payload is base64, under it ROT13, under that a reversed string. Complete `decode_blob` so it returns the plaintext. Two gotchas: `base64.b64de...

### Cybersecurity
- **Spot an injection attempt** (`py-04-sqli`, difficulty 3, 180 pts, pyodide) — You get part of an HTTP query. Complete `is_injection` so it returns `True` when the value looks like a SQL injection attempt: `' OR`, `" OR`, `UNI...

### Ruby
- **Enumerable where a loop would go** (`rb-01-enumerable`, difficulty 2, 130 pts, vm) — This track needs a real interpreter, so in v1 the Ruby labs run in the downloadable lab machine.

### Cybersecurity
- **Redact a card number in a log** (`rb-02-redact`, difficulty 2, 140 pts, vm) — Masking card numbers is real work in logs and incident reports, so this lab starts in the downloadable lab machine.
